methodology: Selected physical-location observations verified against the Maude text, not an exhaustive itinerary. Chapter IDs are global (1–365); paragraph indices are zero-based. Each observation is gated by the chapter where the reader receives it. Some passages report earlier journeys retrospectively, so narrative order must not be mistaken for an exact story-time route. A last recorded sighting does not establish continued presence, being alive, or a current whereabouts. A departure means that the person has left that node; it is not a new destination. Missing observations mean unrecorded, not absent. Notes distinguish explicit arrivals, scene context, and battlefield-area grouping. Geographic markers identify cities or broad battle areas, not exact scene addresses; the fictional estates remain unpinned. Connecting lines show a sequence of sourced observations, not verified travel routes or direct journeys. New-city coordinates are reference markers from the linked geographic sources.
